boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten documented Le Moyne places for quiet study, collaborative work, recreation, reflection, meals and between-class breaks.

cards.title: Reset Between Classes in Corcoran Lounge
cards.subtitle: Soft seating and student games upstairs near the Den
cards.notes: Drop in between classes for a soft chair, or use the pool and foosball tables for a quick screen-free study break.
cards.short_summary: An upstairs student lounge designed for both decompression and casual recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: Le Moyne identifies Corcoran Lounge beside the Den and Student Development offices, with lounge chairs plus pool and foosball tables open to students.
cards.access_notes: Located upstairs next to the Den and across from Student Development; intended for Le Moyne students.

cards.title: Match the Library Floor to the Assignment
cards.subtitle: Collaborative work downstairs, concentrated study upstairs
cards.notes: Use the conversational first floor for group work, then move upstairs when the assignment calls for a designated quiet zone.
cards.short_summary: A two-floor academic space where students can deliberately choose between collaboration and quiet.
cards.evidence_claim: Le Moyne states that the library's first floor supports conversation and group work, while its second floor is a designated quiet zone.
cards.access_notes: Check the library's current weekly hours before visiting; borrowing and some services may require Le Moyne credentials.

cards.entity_name: Keenan Center for Entrepreneurship, Innovation & Creativity
cards.title: Prototype an Idea at the Keenan Center
cards.subtitle: Making, recording and venture support in one student workspace
cards.notes: Bring a defined project idea and ask how to use the 3D printers, laser cutters, podcast studio or startup-support resources.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on campus workspace for prototypes, media production and early-stage business ideas.
cards.evidence_claim: Le Moyne describes the Keenan Center as providing students with 3D printers, laser cutters, a podcast studio and business-startup support.
cards.access_notes: Equipment availability, training requirements and workspace access should be confirmed with the Keenan Center.

cards.title: Take a Short Walk to Barb's Bistro
cards.subtitle: A Salt City Coffee-powered café just off campus
cards.notes: Walk over when you want a café change of scene; check the current menu before choosing among drinks, pastries and sandwiches.
cards.short_summary: A named off-campus-adjacent café that gives students a nearby alternative to campus dining rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Le Moyne says Barb's Bistro is a short walk off campus, is powered by Salt City Coffee and offers drinks, pastries and sandwiches.
cards.access_notes: This is a commercial café just off campus; verify current public hours directly before making the walk.

cards.title: Use the Den Beyond Mealtime
cards.subtitle: Grewen Hall dining with room for studying and meetings
cards.notes: Claim a seat for a study session or group meeting even when you are not ordering, then keep food purchases separate from the plan.
cards.short_summary: A Grewen Hall dining venue whose seating also supports student work and late-day meetups.
cards.evidence_claim: Le Moyne places the Den on Grewen Hall's first floor and explicitly says its seating can be used for studying or group meetings without buying food.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor of Grewen Hall; dining purchases accept the payment methods specified by campus dining.

cards.title: Make Kafé Nuvo the Quick Breakfast Stop
cards.subtitle: Coffee, tea and morning food beside the Den
cards.notes: Use the café for a quick breakfast or drink between commitments, and confirm the day's service hours before heading to Grewen Hall.
cards.short_summary: A compact campus café positioned for breakfast and beverage stops near another dining hub.
cards.evidence_claim: Le Moyne says Kafé Nuvo is next to the Den and serves Starbucks-partner coffee, tea and refreshers along with pastries and breakfast sandwiches.
cards.access_notes: Located beside the Den in Grewen Hall; consult current campus-dining information for operating hours.

cards.title: Move an Afternoon Session to McGill Terrace
cards.subtitle: Outdoor seating with a switch-controlled firepit
cards.notes: Bring cards, reading or a small-group task outdoors; use the firepit only through its provided control and follow posted rules.
cards.short_summary: A recently completed outdoor terrace suited to seated breaks, informal work and sunset views.
cards.evidence_claim: Le Moyne reports that McGill Terrace was completed in summer 2025 and has outdoor seating plus a switch-controlled firepit.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor access is weather-dependent; follow any posted terrace and firepit instructions.

cards.title: Finish a Reading at Curtis Terrace
cards.subtitle: Tables, chairs and green space beside Reilly Hall
cards.notes: Use a table for last-minute reading before class, especially when fair weather makes an outdoor work session practical.
cards.short_summary: A straightforward outdoor study option beside Reilly Hall with both furnished seating and lawn space.
cards.evidence_claim: Le Moyne locates Curtis Terrace beside Reilly Hall and documents tables, chairs and green space for relaxing, reading or studying.
cards.access_notes: This is an outdoor space beside Reilly Hall; usability depends on weather and any campus access restrictions.

cards.title: Choose Your Own Pace at the Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Open recreation and group fitness on the Heights
cards.notes: Check Campus Groups for the current open-recreation schedule, then choose pickup play, individual movement or a fitness class.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation setting where students can exercise independently or join scheduled group activities.
cards.evidence_claim: Le Moyne directs students to the Recreation Center for open recreation such as pickup basketball and pickleball and advertises group fitness classes including barre, TRX, yoga and spin.
cards.access_notes: Consult Campus Groups for the current schedule; facility entry and particular programs may require a Le Moyne ID or registration.

cards.title: Pause at the Panasci Family Chapel
cards.subtitle: Reflection, service and connection through the Grace Center
cards.notes: Visit the Grace Center for a reflective pause or ask staff about current service, cultural-engagement and faith-formation programs.
cards.short_summary: A central campus chapel that also houses a broader hub for reflection, social engagement and service.
cards.evidence_claim: Le Moyne states that the Grace Center for Faith and Community is located in Panasci Family Chapel and brings together reflection, service, cultural engagement and faith formation.
cards.access_notes: Program and worship access varies by event; contact the Grace Center or Campus Ministry for current availability.
